name: Gavel 'ability not ready' right after a Dawn's Arrival reset is the global cooldown, not a leftover cooldown (#10346, #10339)
contract: #10346 and #10339 report that after Dawn's Arrival resets a Gavel's cooldown (the action-bar swipe clears), casting it again briefly fails with 'ability/spell not ready' -- #10339 says this lasts '1-2 seconds' before the cast is finally accepted. AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp's Dawnbreak-cast branch calls AscensionSunCleric::Reduce(player, root, INT32_MAX) for each Gavel root, which for an infinite reduction calls player->RemoveSpellCooldown(spellId, true) (AscensionSunCleric.cpp) -- the exact engine call the CoAGameplayTest 'reset_cooldown' fixture action also makes (src/server/coa/CoAGameplayTest.cpp). Spell::CheckCast (src/server/game/Spells/Spell.cpp) returns the identical SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY (67) for two unrelated conditions: Player::HasSpellCooldown(spellId) (the ability's own per-spell cooldown) and, separately and unconditionally, Spell::HasGlobalCooldown() (the ordinary 1.5 s GCD, StartRecoveryCategory 133 / StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms, shared by Dawnbreak and every Gavel). Casting Dawnbreak itself starts a fresh GCD at the exact moment its OnSpellCast hook calls Reduce(); recasting a Gavel in that same instant is rejected by the still-running GCD with the same 'not ready' message a real cooldown would produce, even though the Gavel's own per-spell cooldown entry was already erased. This scenario reproduces the engine mechanism deterministically with reset_cooldown standing in for Reduce()'s RemoveSpellCooldown call at the same point in the timeline (right after a Dawnbreak-equivalent cast starts the GCD): the immediate recast fails with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY purely from the GCD, and the SAME ability succeeds well under 2 seconds later -- far short of its normal 5-second cooldown -- proving the per-spell cooldown really was cleared and the brief 'not ready' window is the unavoidable global cooldown, not a defect in the reset.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Put Gavel of Grace on its normal cooldown
SETUP: Gavel of Grace is accepted
SETUP: Gavel of Grace is now on cooldown
Wait for the global cooldown to clear
Cast Dawnbreak: in the live reset path, OnSpellCast calls Reduce() exactly here, before a fresh GCD elapses
Stand in for Reduce()'s RemoveSpellCooldown(800614, true) call
SETUP: the per-spell cooldown entry is genuinely cleared
Immediately recast Gavel of Grace, same instant as the Dawnbreak-started GCD
CONTRACT: the immediate recast fails with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY purely from the Dawnbreak-started GCD, not a leftover ability cooldown
CONTRACT (#10339): the ability becomes castable again within ~2 seconds, far under its normal 5-second cooldown
Retry once the global cooldown has cleared
CONTRACT: the retry succeeds, proving the per-spell cooldown clear genuinely worked
